name: fara-portfolio-site
description: Cloudflare Workers への公開用（wrangler のバージョン固定）。サイト本体は src/FaraPortfolio.Web（Blazor WebAssembly。公開する静的サイトは publish/wwwroot）

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['publish','artifacts','dist','src/FaraPortfolio.Web/bin','src/FaraPortfolio.Web/obj','tools/PrerenderPages/bin','tools/PrerenderPages/obj','tests/FaraPortfolio.Tests/bin','tests/FaraPortfolio.Tests/obj']) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.publish:site: npm run clean && dotnet publish src/FaraPortfolio.Web -c Release -o publish && npm run build:pages
scripts.publish:site:develop: npm run clean && dotnet publish src/FaraPortfolio.Web -c Release -o publish && npm run build:pages:develop
scripts.build:pages: dotnet run --project tools/PrerenderPages -c Release --no-launch-profile -- --data publish/wwwroot/data --host fara-labs.com --out artifacts/pages.json --not-found-out artifacts/not-found.json && node tools/build-pages.mjs --env production
scripts.build:pages:develop: dotnet run --project tools/PrerenderPages -c Release --no-launch-profile -- --data publish/wwwroot/data --host dev.fara-labs.com --out artifacts/pages.json --not-found-out artifacts/not-found.json && node tools/build-pages.mjs --env develop
scripts.check: npm run publish:site && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env develop
